facts.label: Starter-zone book
facts.value: Starting zones drop quest items that teach a gathering profession and give +2 skill. The mining one is Mining for Dummies.

facts.label: Scarce ores
facts.value: Mining can also yield scarce Pyrite, Bauxite and Pitchblende.

facts.label: New bars
facts.value: Heavy Thorium Bar is smelted at a Molten Foundry, Azerothium Bar is made from Pitchblende and Coal (Mining 275), and Legionite Bar is an Alchemy transmute.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Lodestone at skill 20, Rock Garden at 140 (blueprint from the Relic Guardian in the Excavation Site: Wetlands) and Molten Foundry at 300.

facts.label: No Jewelcrafting
facts.value: Blizzard's starter guide lists 12 professions. Jewelcrafting and Inscription are not among them.

facts.label: Level for each rank
facts.value: Guides disagree. Icy Veins lists no level for Journeyman, 10 for Expert and 25 for Artisan; Warcraft Tavern lists 10, 20 and 35, the same as crafts.

facts.label: Legacy perks
facts.value: Bountiful Harvest gives extra Scarce resources from gathering, and Working Overtime improves your skill-up chance.

facts.label: Lodestone
facts.value: The Lodestone's buff matches Blessing of Might (melee attack power) and does not stack with it, so it helps most in groups without a Paladin.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Where the Molten Foundry blueprint drops; Heavy Thorium Bars are smelted there.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: When Heavy Thorium, Azerothium and Legionite become available, and where the new ores spawn.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether any passive mining perk exists. The +5% health claim and mining creatures after death appear only in unverified lists.
